notes: Single-stage with an internal dependency: implement a four-algorithm digest chain (md5 -> sha512 over a truncation -> blake2b over concatenated truncations -> sha3_256 mixed with the original bytes) exactly, then apply it via a CLI to shipped and hidden binary inputs including empty and all-byte-value files. Rubric nonzero for dependent_stages (each stage feeds the next), reasoning_depth (truncation/order subtleties), adversarial_inputs (empty and adversarial binaries), hidden_case_generalization, and quantitative_correctness (byte-exact hex digests). No tool breadth or environment pressure; totals bucket to medium.
